statement: For every simple99-vertex integer degree14 graph A, with integer R=A^2+A-12I-2J and M=R mod3, a residual row with c1,c2 nonzero residue counts has beta=2c1+c2 divisible by3, beta<=3floor(2deg_H/3), and each paired residual of residue0,1,2 is at most beta,beta-2,beta-1 respectively; equal outside-whole-support neighborhoods of u,v imply CN(u,v)>=14-floor(|S|/2), hence when |S|<=11 both support degrees are at least5.
